description: A mobile app welcome screen with a Sign in with suiss bottom sheet for sharing or hiding an email.
overview: A mobile app welcome screen whose Sign in with suiss button slides up a bottom sheet, where users choose to share or hide their email before continuing. Completing the flow greets the user with a Sign out link. From small tablets up the screen sits in a phone frame; on the smallest screens it fills the section. Use it for third-party sign-in or any consent step shown as a bottom sheet.
usage: Replace `proceed`, which fakes a one-second request, with your identity provider's sign-in, and send the chosen email option along. Update the Trail Routes app name, tagline and account details, and give Continue with email a handler.
notes: The sheet behaves as a modal dialog: focus moves into it, Escape or a click on the scrim closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.
